notes.title: Highway Blossoms 1.2.5 — Maintenance Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Highway Blossoms 1.2.5 has just been released, which fixes a few minor issues.

As always, thank you for continuing to support Studio Élan!

〜 Karen/あけみ (akemin_dayo) and adirosa

Changelog for 1.2.5:
On PC, it targets Ren'Py SDK versions 8.1.3.23091805 〜 7.5.3.22090809.


 Certain trophies will no longer unlock simply by opening the preference pane. You have to unlock them the intended way now.
 Made a certain Goofball Mode feature easier to find in the UI.
 Merged changes and improvements made in common code shared with other Studio Élan games.
	
	 Improved graphical sharpness and presentation on the Steam Deck when launched via SteamOS Gaming Mode (`gamescope`). (※ Specifically, the game will now always launch in fullscreen mode if launched from SteamOS `gamescope`. Running the game from the KDE desktop environment is unaffected by this change.)
	 You can now scroll CGs with the keyboard in the CG viewer by holding down the arrow keys instead of having to rapidly tap them.
	
 Made various other internal refactors and improvements.


※ Newer copies of the Gold Rush Edition physical PC release will be using 1.2.5 going forward, instead of the previous 1.2.

notes.title: Highway Blossoms 1.2.3 — Maintenance Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Highway Blossoms 1.2.3 has just been released, which fixes a few issues of varying severity!

Of particular note, this release fixes the "FTFont NoneType" crash that was affecting certain users — thank you to everyone that reported and helped test this elusive issue, as we were completely unable to reproduce this on our local testing environments without your help! And our apologies for all the inconvenience that was experienced.

Additionally, using the Steam "Betas" feature to downgrade to 1.1.1, 1.1, and 1.0 should now work correctly, fixing the "unsupported pickle protocol: 5" error. (※ You may need to restart your Steam client for the changes to take effect, as the changes were made to Steamworks metadata and not to any actual game code or data.)

Thank you all for remaining patient, and as always, thank you for continuing to support Studio Élan!

〜 Karen/あけみ (akemin_dayo) and adirosa
Changelog for 1.2.3:
On PC, it targets Ren'Py SDK versions 8.1.3.23091805 〜 7.5.3.22090809.
Fixed the infamous "FTFont NoneType" crash that would occur only for certain users when attempting to draw a text box.Running Highway Blossoms 1.2.3 at least once will apply modifications to your persistent save data in such a way that downgrading back to any version that was previously affected by the crash (1.2.2 〜 1.2) will now work on system configurations that were previously crashing.※ Note for people running downgraded versions: Fully deleting your persistent save data while on an affected version above will cause the crash to come back until 1.2.3 or newer is run at least once again to fix up your persistent save data.Fixed a crash that would occur if the user navigated to Marina's Thoughts, then to either the CG Gallery or the Guest Art sections in that specific order.Fixed the wrong item name being used for the "Miner's Journal" (as "Hiker's Journal") in Marina's Thoughts.Fixed a typo in the "Cassette" item (as "Casette") in Marina's Thoughts.Made various other internal refactors and improvements.

notes.title: Highway Blossoms: Next Exit & Artbook Release, Base Game Update
notes.notes:
Heyo everyone,

Lots of big news today. The main ones, of course, are the releases of Highway Blossoms: Next Exit and the artbook! I've talked about those a bunch before, so I won't repeat myself too much here. Go pick them up!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/490270/Highway_Blossoms_Next_Exit/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1412300/Highway_Blossoms__Official_Artbook/

To access Highway Blossoms: Next Exit, go to the "Extras" tab from the main menu (which may require beating the game once to unlock) and then go to "DLC Content." You'll be able to start the DLC story from there!

Alongside that, we've got a big update for the base Highway Blossoms game again, arguably even bigger than the Remastered update a couple years ago. Buckle in, because it's about to get bumpy.

Longtime HB fans might not be surprised to see this, but unfortunately, this update is likely going to break your saves. It's an unfortunate result of the engine that we use for Highway Blossoms (more specifically some custom modifications to it) and there's not really a way to avoid it. We're sorry for the inconvenience 😔 You can hold down ctrl to quickly skip through text to get back to where you were before.

Broken saves is the only bad news, though. Now onto the good!

The first change you'll probably notice is the new GUI in the game. We've totally renovated all of the menus and interface, and added some extra features. For one, there are new accessibility options, and a light/dark mode for the game. Now you can play Good Highway Blossoms and Evil Highway Blossoms. There's also a new music player and improved art gallery (make sure to check out the Next Exit guest art too!).

In the gallery, you might notice a new section called "Marina's Thoughts." We've added a number of cut-in illustrations throughout the game for certain items that come up in the story - stuff like the journal, the gold, meals the girls eat, and more. In addition to seeing them in-game, you can check them out in the gallery as well, for a quick opinion from Marina on each item.

There are a couple other new sections that you can find under "Extras" in the Legacy Content area. For one thing, you can now find all things Goofball mode here: EZ Mode, Extreme Mode, and the new form of Goofball mode itself: rather than requiring a whole other playthrough with a couple changed lines, Goofball mode is now in more of a highlight reel format that simply features The Jokes. We did remove a couple jokes that we felt weren't in good taste, though.

On that note, the Jumbo Scene from the original game has also been moved to the Legacy Content area. This means that the scene is no longer part of a playthrough of the regular game. However, you can reread that scene in its entirety from the menu.

Finally, we made the slightest of changes to music in the game, by adding one new track. It's a song that was written for Next Exit, but we chose to add it into the base game too. If you own the soundtrack DLC here on Steam, you'll automatically get the new tracks from Next Exit - even if you don't own Next Exit itself. Instead you can listen to the songs and imagine how they might be used, I suppose.

A Chinese translation for Next Exit is in the works, and will be added as soon as it's completed. Also, 'cause I've seen a few people asking: there's no new adult content or new Goofball Mode content in Next Exit.

Whether you play NE or not, we hope you enjoy these newest improvements to Highway Blossoms. Can't wait to be on my deathbed in a few decades and still rolling out updates to the game then.

notes.title: Optional Update - Version 1.32
notes.notes:
We've pushed an optional update for Highway Blossoms to the beta branch of the game. As with the other updates we've pushed, it'll most likely corrupt saves, which is why we're not setting it to the main branch of the game yet. 

Here's what it does:

• Implemented small and medium sized screen device UI. Doesn’t affect Steam users except for some extreme cases where the OS might expose itself as a tablet or phone interface. If you're playing on a calculator, this is the update for you.

• Fixed some sprite positioning errors caused by the previous patch’s ghosting fixes. It's a trickle-down bugfix process.

• Fixed a ton of spelling and continuity errors thanks to the efforts of the Steam community. Marina no longer randomly gains and loses a sibling.

• Added small notification in main menu to let you know if the adult content has been installed properly. ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)


•Implemented a slower but more robust saving system and a slightly reduced rollback limit to hopefully help with the constant save breaking.

•Can now hide the Gallery navigation menu with the H key. Fitting button, right?

•EZ Mode only plays "The Bear Prayer" in a single channel, rather than twice at once. We have been informed that that that's not how stereo audio works.

•In Skip mode, switching between "Read" and "All" is now a toggle. Trying to word that sentence was roughly as confusing as explaining how it worked before.

As stated, right now this is available as a beta update, which means that you have to opt-in to download it. To do that, find Highway Blossoms in your Steam library, right-click (or equivalent) on the title, and go to "Properties." Then, under the "betas" tab, choose "betafixes" from the drop-down menu at the top. You should immediately begin to download the patch. There is no password required.

Like always, thank you very much for playing Highway Blossoms! ^.^

notes.title: Version Update - 1.24
notes.notes:
We had another update - this one is pretty small and won't break any saves (unless we did something horribly, horribly wrong).

In addition to a super minor Tess positioning error, the main thing this update does is disable F.Skip, a function that allows you to skip to the next choice in a VN.

This is a very useful feature for VN's that aren't Highway Blossoms, as apparently it causes crashes in games without choices. Our bad.

Thanks to user bjiadokc who pointed out the issue.

Pay your respects to F.Skip in the comments if you like.

notes.title: Version Update - 1.22
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We have a smallish patch that fixes a few things; see below for the full list. Unfortunately, this one will definitely corrupt save files, as we changed the save directory, so you’ll need to restart the game. However, you can quickly get back to where you were by opening the in-game menu, changing the “Skip text” option to “Skip All Messages” (not just “read messages,” as the patch will reset what it thinks you’ve read before), and holding control. You can also press tab to toggle skip mode on/off. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Highway Blossoms: The Definitive Version Until We Realize Something Else is Wrong

-Corrects multiple typos and grammatical errors. We r good @ writng
-Fixed an issue with some of the journal entries not triggering correctly. Amber is no longer clairvoyant and doesn’t randomly know where to go next.
-Adjusts visual direction and smooths out sprite animation. Our programmer says we enabled subpixel, whatever that means ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
-Opening credits adjusted for consistency, and to actually properly credit everyone (Sorry Rosu!)
-Adds CG gallery accessible from extras menu. Yes, it includes all installed CG’s ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)
-Fixes issue of ghost sprites when skipping text. This is not a horror game.
-Ambient sounds now cut out when they should. Leaving the engine running all through the Grand Canyon is bad for the environment.
-Repaired Amber’s hand in one of the driving CG’s. She’s now shadier.
-Broke your saves again
